desc: A "car crashing" sound effect produced from ATX side-panels landing multiple times on each other for the main base in my bedroom. With the mass and weight of the object being the main influence of the metallic impact, this factors into when it is imported and is given time-stretching - these sounds produce varying levels of metallic resonance each time which can be mixed, manipulated and pitched. Glass which I smashed previously had been placed at the apex of the metal impact with the trailing shatter adding a matching disharmonic and sense of chaos to the sound.
title: Car Crash (with Glass)
author: magnuswaker
